caption: The four marks lines pass left to right: grep removes Ravi, sed changes the first space to a comma, and awk keeps scores of at least 60 and prints the count and total. Notice that the final output is 3 229, not the selected lines.

spec.title: grep to sed to awk
spec.aria: Marks lines pass through grep to drop Ravi, sed changes the space to a comma, and awk keeps scores at least 60 and prints count 3 and sum 229.
